_comment: Copy to configs/sources.json and edit. Every source needs a concrete license and a rights_basis. Paths are relative to the directory you run from. The pipeline records what you assert here; it cannot verify it.

sources.name: kowiki
sources.notes: ShareAlike: redistributed derived text must keep CC BY-SA. Extract from the official dump (dumps.wikimedia.org) with wikiextractor or similar.

sources.name: fineweb2-ko
sources.notes: ODC-By covers the compilation; copyright in individual web pages is separate and is subject to CommonCrawl terms of use. Needs `pip install pyarrow`.

sources.name: kr-statutes
sources.notes: Statutes, ordinances and court rulings are not protected works under Art. 7 of the Korean Copyright Act. Commentary or annotations added by publishers can be protected; keep only the official text.
